retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical psychedelic mandala featuring a central geometric frame with radiating perspective lines and stylized iconography, surrounded by tall, condensed Art Nouveau-inspired typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square frame containing a stylized face or glasses motif with internal sun and palm tree icons, set against a radiating sunburst. This core is nested within a symmetrical, multi-lobed geometric mandala structure, all placed on a dark, solid background with a border of vertical and horizontal text.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square frame as the primary focal point
Symmetrical lobes radiating from the center in a cross pattern
Radiating perspective lines creating depth within the central frame
Tall, condensed typography framing the central graphic
coreInvariants: Warm color palette of yellow, orange, and pink against dark brown

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The geometric mandala is centered and occupies approximately 70% of the canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central square frame with the stylized glasses/face motif.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central icon, move outward along the mandala lobes, and then circle the perimeter following the text border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark brown negative space surrounds the central mandala, providing high contrast.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and orange for the mandala structure
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pink and teal within the central illustration
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation warm tones against a low-value, desaturated dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Internal horizontal bars for E, F, and A are placed high
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and D are elongated vertical ovals
A has a very high crossbar
G has a simplified, geometric hook
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Tall, stylized display type for main titles paired with wide, simple sans-serif for perimeter details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, blocky, and playful 60s vibe

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a symmetrical psychedelic mandala on a dark brown background. The center should feature a square frame with a sunburst and stylized icons like a sun and palm tree. Surround the square with four semi-circular lobes containing smaller circles, all in yellow and orange tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed, tall yellow display text at the top and bottom center. Add small, wide-tracked yellow sans-serif text running vertically along the left and right edges, separated by dots.

verificationChecks: Is the display text extremely tall and narrow?
Is the background a solid dark brown?
Are the colors limited to a warm 60s palette?

adjustableVariables: Number of lobes in the mandala
Width of the perimeter text border
mustRedesign: Any specific band names or song titles
Exact hand-drawn illustrations of the palm and sun

mustAchieve: Vibrant contrast between yellow and dark brown

postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the central mandala
Ensure the vertical text is oriented correctly along the edges
Verify the ultra-condensed font maintains legibility
Confirm the color palette is strictly warm tones on dark brown
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Geometric Mandala + Ultra-Condensed Display Type + Warm Retro Palette
